## Summary
Lenses checked: correctness, silent-failure, tests, comments.
`test_rejects_legacy_header` needs fixing because it can't fail for the version check it names. The other added test, `test_rejects_unsupported_header_with_complete_report`, does exercise the new check.

## Changes
`parse_report` now accepts only the exact header `REPORT v1` instead of any line starting with `REPORT `. The pull request also adds two tests for rejected headers.

## Critical
(none)

## Important
- tests/test_report.py:10 — tests — Make test_rejects_legacy_header reach the header check — The fixture `"REPORT v1\nversion=v1"` becomes `"REPORT v1\nversion=v0"` after the `rsplit` swap: the header stays `v1` and there is no `END` line, so `app/report.py:3` returns `None` before the version check runs. The comment "changing the fixture's version to v0" describes a header change that the code doesn't make. — This test also passes with the old `startswith("REPORT ")` check, so it gives no regression protection for the version check. — Fix: Use a complete report with a legacy header, such as `"REPORT v0\nvalue=ok\nEND"`, or delete the test, since `test_rejects_unsupported_header_with_complete_report` already covers that input.
